nota: Tiempos exactos: la pista es la concatenación de los audios de cada segmento con pausas fijas.

segmentos.texto: Hi there! What can I get you?
Hi. A large coffee with some milk, please.
Sure. Do you want any sugar?
No, thanks. I don't take sugar.
And a tea for me, please. Do you have any lemon?
Sorry, we don't have any lemon today. But we have some honey.
OK, a little honey, then. How much are the cookies?
They're a dollar fifty each. But there are only a few left. Just three.
Yes, but not many. There's a cheese sandwich and a chicken sandwich.
So that's a large coffee with milk, a tea with honey, two cookies and a cheese sandwich. That's thirteen dollars and fifty cents.
It's my turn today. I'm paying!
